performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Async signal receivers rejected 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>Every changed Signal.send call now omits _async_wrapper=app.ensure_sync, so Blinker raises when
>a connected receiver is a coroutine instead of executing it synchronously. This breaks async
>receivers across request, exception, teardown, context, flash, and template signals, causing the
>associated operation to fail.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/app.py[1016]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6236/files#diff-d3e0349504081bb501c611b3954be364188a4cf442056181272e27e830ae446eR1016-R1016) > >```diff >+ request_started.send(self) >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>Flask's exported signals are ordinary Blinker namespace signals, and the project requires Blinker
>1.9 or newer. Blinker's send documentation states that _async_wrapper is called to convert
>coroutine receivers into synchronous callables; removing it from these synchronous sends therefore
>eliminates the mechanism that ran async receivers. For example, request_started.send executes
>before request preprocessing and dispatch, while appcontext_pushed.send executes after the context
>variable is set, so the resulting receiver error can abort request processing or leave a partially
>completed context push.
>
> > [src/flask/signals.py[3-17]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/44868e084e530ec99deffa539e61801973b0ce80/src/flask/signals.py/#L3-L17) > [pyproject.toml[23-33]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/44868e084e530ec99deffa539e61801973b0ce80/pyproject.toml/#L23-L33) > [src/flask/app.py[1013-1022]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/44868e084e530ec99deffa539e61801973b0ce80/src/flask/app.py/#L1013-L1022) > [src/flask/ctx.py[430-435]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/44868e084e530ec99deffa539e61801973b0ce80/src/flask/ctx.py/#L430-L435) > 🌐 [Blinker documents that synchronous `Signal.send()` uses `_async_wrapper` to turn async coroutine receivers into synchronous callables.](https://blinker.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The PR removed Flask's `ensure_sync` adapter from every public signal dispatch. Blinker requires `_async_wrapper` when synchronous `send()` encounters coroutine receivers, otherwise it raises instead of invoking them. > >## Issue Context >Restore `_async_wrapper=self.ensure_sync` or `_async_wrapper=app.ensure_sync` as appropriate at every modified signal send, and add regression coverage using async receivers for representative request, context, flash, and template signals. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/app.py[929-929] >- src/flask/app.py[1016-1016] >- src/flask/app.py[1045-1045] >- src/flask/app.py[1450-1450] >- src/flask/app.py[1478-1478] >- src/flask/ctx.py[434-434] >- src/flask/ctx.py[502-502] >- src/flask/helpers.py[351-355] >- src/flask/templating.py[126-128] >- src/flask/templating.py[164-168] >- tests/test_signals.py[1-181] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
Context sources
✅ Web pages:
  🌐 https://blinker.readthedocs.io/en/stable/
  🌐 src/blinker/base.py
  🌐 Add a send_async method to the Signal
  +2 more
Review mode: ⚖️ Balanced: This changes signal dispatch behavior across Flask’s request, application-context, exception, teardown, and template paths, so compatibility with async receivers and edge cases warrants a complete single-pass review.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
